observations: Large solar panel standing vertically against a wall.
Silver aluminum frame with a white top rail.
Multiple dark blue photovoltaic cells arranged in a grid.
Two black mounting brackets are attached to the frame.
The panel is leaning at an angle on a tiled floor.
A watermark 'Jiji' is visible across the center of the image.
The panel appears to be in a clean, unused condition.

claims.evidence: The wattage rating is not visible in the photo.
The cell type cannot be determined from the photo.

risks.risk: The panel may be a lower wattage model (e.g., 350W) or a different technology (poly).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be non-functional or have internal cell damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc).

risks.risk: The panel may be a counterfeit or replica.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number and the manufacturer's label on the back.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Photo of the serial number on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing the panel's output voltage and current.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
